plugins.name: project-spec
plugins.description: Generate project, feature, and design specifications with a single /spec-writing command. Features adaptive routing, gap analysis, design audit, and codebase-aware interviews.

plugins.name: suno-composer
plugins.description: Creative or guided workflow for composing Suno AI songs. Vision-first mode (Claude proposes, you react) or guided mode (step-by-step wizard). Features narrative style prompts, artist profiles, J-pop tier presets, adaptive preference learning, conversational intent detection, album mode, variations, and song continuations.

plugins.name: kana-code-rpc
plugins.description: Display Claude Code activity as Discord Rich Presence. Shows project name, current activity (tool use, thinking, compacting, waiting), model, context usage, cost, git branch, lines changed, and a repository link button. Features PID-based multi-session tracking, idle detection, MCP tool support, and YAML configuration with hot-reload.

plugins.name: anipy-cli
plugins.description: Use Claude Code as a natural language interface for anipy-cli — search, play, download, and manage anime from the terminal on Windows. Self-healing dependency repair (uv, scoop, mpv/vlc) with user confirmation, non-interactive execution via Git Bash, and Windows-specific troubleshooting.
